emotional_core: The act of creating freely inevitably creates watchers, and the watchers change the act — so the only way back to unselfconsciousness is through, not around.
visual_metaphor: A person dancing alone in a large empty room — window light cutting across the floor — not performing for the light, just moving through it.
key_quotes: Dance anyway. Not for the encore. For the ache in your chest that finally has somewhere to go.
The unobserved moments keep your center of gravity low.
The self-consciousness only goes away inside the doing.

story_frames.visual: Black screen, single line of white text fading in — no image, no music cue, just words in serif.
story_frames.text: There's a move you keep holding back.

story_frames.visual: Phone screen glowing red record indicator in a dark room — blurred figure moving in the background.
Poem lines appearing one at a time over a still of an empty amber-lit room, dust visible in the light.
Split screen: left — person moving freely, unaware; right — same person now aware of a camera, movement slightly stiffened.
Close-up of hands writing in a notebook, no audience, no performance — pen moving without hesitation.
Notes app on a phone — a half-finished draft visible, cursor blinking mid-sentence.
Return to the first image — person alone in the lit room — now moving fully, without looking back at any mirror.
